svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class that encapsulates MIPI DSI host driver callback. User code can extend this class, add implementations to one or more of the callback methods. The user's callback class is then instantiated in the testbench and registered with the driver of interest.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback::post_response_lane_transaction_get
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_host host , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback called by driver after pulling a transaction descriptor out of its input port, but before acting on the transaction descriptor.

host - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_host driver that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if sets by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.

 svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback::pre_host_driver_packet_out_port_write
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_host host , svt_mipi_dsi_packet data  ) 

If user doesn't drop the formed response packet from pre_host_driver_packet_out_port callback, then this callback will be called and then DSI Host driver will broadcast that formed response packet. The purpose of this method is to verify received response packet before broadcasting.

host - Reference to the driver object issuing this callback.

data - Reference to the data descriptor object of interest.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_host_callback::response_lane_transaction_cov
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_host host , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact  ) 

Called after pulling a transaction descriptor out of the lane 0, but before acting on the transaction descriptor in any way. This callback is used for coverage and called if lane transaction was not dropped by previously executed callback.

host - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_host driver that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.
